verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents signed real-time webhooks for events such as registrations, renewals, transfers and DNS changes. Those only notify an external consumer, so they are a developer building block: the user must build and host the rule-and-action logic themselves. Auto-renewal is a single fixed built-in behavior, not a user-defined event→action rule, and no first-party rules or automation engine is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Get signed, real-time events (registrations, renewals, transfers, DNS changes) instead of polling.
